newsitem.title: FRANCE: Several brokers cut SGS-Thomson forecasts.
newsitem.headline: Several brokers cut SGS-Thomson forecasts.

text.p: Several brokerages have cut their forecasts for SGS-Thomson Microelectronics the day after it posted 48 percent lower first half results, fund managers said.
Cheuvreux de Virieu maintains its "2" (buy) recommendation but sees a 1997 earnings per share of $3.20 instead of $3.40 while maintaining its 1998 forecast of $4.95.

Jean D'Anjou of Societe Generale reduced his 1997 estimate to $3.20 from $3.32 and kept his 1998 forecast at $4.97 as well as his "buy" recommendation. He has a price target of 590-600 francs, which would be 20 times 1998 earnings.
BNP Equities reduced its 1997 forecast by five percent to $3.35 from $3.55 and its 1998 estimate by three percent to $4.50 from $4.65 and changed its "buy" recommendation to "overweight".
At 1349, SGS-Thomson shares were 1.86 percent higher at 547 francs. They had fallen 4.28 percent on Thursday.
